dataset: option40 - IV mean signal test (completely different signal type)
hypothesis: IV mean = (call IV + put IV) / 2 measures overall vol level, fundamentally different from IV skew (call-put). Much less popular fields (8-30 users vs 15-73). Might have lower prod_corr.

analysis.conclusion: IV mean is a DEAD signal. All 8 alphas have Sharpe ~0.00 (range: -0.02 to 0.02). IV mean (overall vol level) has NO cross-sectional predictive power for stock returns after SLOW_AND_FAST neutralization. The vol level is already captured by the risk model and fully neutralized away. Only IV skew (call-put differential) carries unique predictive information.
analysis.key_insight: IV skew works because it captures risk sentiment/distribution asymmetry NOT captured by standard risk models. IV mean fails because vol level IS captured by risk models and fully neutralized.
analysis.implication: Option40 dataset optimization is EXHAUSTED. IV skew is the only viable signal, and its prod_corr cannot be reduced below 0.7 by any tenor/neutralization/transformation combination tested.
